claim.claim-text: 1. A device mounted on a vehicle comprising:

2. The device according to claim 1, further comprising a storage unit storing a combination of the versions of the software permitted to executed previous to switching and a combination of the versions of the switched software permitted to executed, wherein, after the second instruction unit instructs to restore the switched software to the software previous to switching:

the acquisition unit is configured to acquire the version information of the software of the on-board devices; and the confirmation unit is configured to confirm whether the versions of the software mounted on the on-board devices has the consistency by comparing the version information acquired by the acquisition unit after instructing and the combination of the versions of the software permitted to executed previous to switching.

3. The device according to claim 1, further comprising a transmission unit configured to transmit the version information acquired by the acquisition unit, wherein the second instruction unit is configured to instruct the on-board devices to restore the switched software to the software previous to switching when i) the confirmation unit confirms that the versions of the switched software mounted on the on-board devices do not have the consistency and ii) the transmission unit is unable to communicate with an external server.

4. The device according to claim 3, further comprising a reception unit configured to receive, from the external server, confirmation result information confirmed by the external server based on the version information that is transmitted by the transmission unit, the confirmation result information indicating whether the versions of the software mounted on the on-board devices have the consistency, wherein, when iii) the confirmation unit confirms that the versions of the switched software mounted on the on-board devices do not have the consistency and iv) the transmission unit is able to communicate with the external server,

the transmission unit is configured to transmit the version information to the external server acquired by the acquisition unit, the reception unit is configured to receive the confirmation result information from the external server, and the confirmation unit is configured to confirm whether the versions of the software mounted on the on-board devices have the consistency based on the confirmation result information received by the reception unit.

5. The device according to claim 1, wherein the confirmation unit is configured to permit to execute predetermined vehicle control that is implemented by the on-board devices when the confirmation unit confirms that the versions of the software mounted on the on-board devices have the consistency.
6. A vehicle comprising the device according to claim 1.
